title: Solve the dual two pushes at a time
brief: Clip a pair of pushes to the box, jump to the top of the one-variable parabola, and repeat on whichever houses break the checklist.
hints: The pair must keep alpha_i y_i + alpha_j y_j constant. With different labels that means alpha_i - alpha_j is constant, and with the same labels alpha_i + alpha_j is constant. Intersect that line with the square [0, C] x [0, C] and read off the ends of alpha_j.
Read both scores before you change either alpha. E_i = f_i - y_i uses the old alpha and b. Reading E_j after writing alpha_i is the usual mistake.
The top of the parabola is alpha_j + y_j * (E_i - E_j) / eta, with eta = K[i, i] + K[j, j] - 2 * K[i, j]. Clip it to [L, H], then recover alpha_i = alpha_i + y_i * y_j * (alpha_j_old - alpha_j_new).
Return the inputs unchanged when i == j, when eta <= 1e-12, or when L >= H. Copy alpha before you write to it.
In fit_smo, the test for house i is the KKT test in per-house form: y_i * E_i is the same number as g_i. Update i only when y_i * E_i < -tol with alpha_i < C, or y_i * E_i > tol with alpha_i > 0.
